recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（CD8 對 CD4），非形態影像；主要藍色族群 CD8 強陽性並同時帶有弱至中度 CD4，呈 CD4/CD8 共表現的樣式，與旁邊正常的 CD4 單陽性（紅）及 CD8 單陽性（洋紅）族群不同。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD8-ECD (x-axis) versus CD4-APC750 (y-axis), gate labeled [AZ]
Dominant blue population with bright CD8 (about 10^2) and CD4 expression ranging from dim to moderate (about 10^0 to 10^1.5)
Small red CD4-positive, CD8-negative population consistent with residual normal CD4 T cells
Magenta CD8-bright, CD4-negative events adjacent to the blue cluster, consistent with residual CD8 T cells
Green/magenta CD4-negative to dim, CD8-negative events at lower left
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot displays CD8 versus CD4 expression within the gated population. The dominant population (blue) expresses bright CD8 with a continuum of dim to moderate CD4, indicating CD4/CD8 co-expression, and is distinct from the small residual CD4 single-positive (red) and CD8 single-positive (magenta) populations. A double-negative group of events is present at the lower left. CD4 and CD8 co-expression by a mature expanded T-cell population is seen in about a quarter of cases of T-prolymphocytic leukemia and is rare in other mature T-cell leukemias, supporting the given diagnosis.
